problem: Express $\sqrt{5}-2\sqrt{5}{sin}^{2}⁡{42}^{∘}$ as a single trigonometric ratio.
worked_solution:
Our expression can be factored as follows:

$$
\sqrt{5}(1-2{sin}^{2}⁡{42}^{∘})
$$

Now, let's recall the double-angle formula for cosine:

$$
1-2{sin}^{2}⁡x=\operatorname{cos}⁡2x
$$

Substituting $x={42}^{∘}$ into the above, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}1-2{sin}^{2}⁡{42}^{∘} & =\operatorname{cos}⁡(2\cdot {42}^{∘})=\operatorname{cos}⁡{84}^{∘}.\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we obtain 

$$
\begin{aligned}\sqrt{5}(1-2{sin}^{2}⁡{42}^{∘}) & =\sqrt{5}\operatorname{cos}⁡{84}^{∘}.\end{aligned}
$$
